note: Full Molt (reversed) overlay for the 14-card Suit of Plumes. Each card gains a 'reversed' + 'molt' block; uprightMeaning aliases each card's existing coreMeaning. signal plumes_08 reused verbatim from the sample. Display-suit pips molt mostly blocked/shadow; the Ten flips toward renewal where tradition releases the burden. Still anatomically bird, streetwear-fitted, pixel-art, no gore.
accentMoltRule: warm+inward/deficiency -> drained ash; any+shadow/renewal -> oil-slick iridescent; cool+blocked -> frost-dimmed

cards.uprightMeaning: Resonance of inspiration, raw potential, new drive

reversed.meaning: The flash refuses to catch — false start, delays, lack of drive, an idea that fizzles before it lights.
reversed.gameplayFantasy: Molt mode stutters: the opening signal is delayed a turn but hits twice as loud when it finally lands.

molt.featherState: wingbeat ragged, the lit feather guttering, two loose feathers caught on the antenna
molt.lighting: cold uplight off the rooftop instead of warm noon key
molt.borderState: signal filigree guttering out at the corners
